title: Madhya-khanda, part 16 (portion 39)
html:
The section "The Lord's Sannyasa" (beginning): at dawn the Lord leaves Navadvipa and swims across the Ganga; the lament of Shachi, Vishnupriya and the devotees; Nityananda with Chandrashekhara and others follows the Lord; the Lord in Kantakanagara with Keshava Bharati; Bharati hesitates to give Him sannyasa, and the Lord whispers the sannyasa mantra into his ear; the grief of the people of Kantakanagara; the Lord asks for their blessing

The Lord's Sannyasa

Summary by Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati. [Sri Gaurasundara, having consoled the devotees] with instruction in the truth, [left home] and, in order to take sannyasa, crossed the Ganga and came to Katwa, to Keshava Bharati. [Mother Shachi and] Vishnupriya [were overwhelmed] in separation from the Lord; Nityananda Prabhu, consoling them, came with Chandrashekhara Acharya, Damodara Pandita and other devotees to the Lord in Kantakanagara. The Lord asked Keshava Bharati for sannyasa, but he would not agree to give Him sannyasa. Then Bhagavan Himself, [wishing to receive] the sannyasa mantra and knowing what was in Bharati's heart, on some pretext first spoke the sannyasa mantra into Keshava Bharati's ear, and then Bharati agreed to give Him sannyasa. All the inhabitants of Kantakanagara — children, old people, youths, women and men — lamented bitterly on seeing the Lord's sannyasa; Sri Gaurachandra consoled them and, [bearing Himself] as a devotee, asked them for [the blessing of] devotion to Krishna. [A voice from the sky proclaimed the name "Sri Krishna Chaitanya": the Lord] awakened [all to Krishna] — therefore His name in sannyasa became "Sri Krishna Chaitanya". Then, having taken sannyasa, Sriman Mahaprabhu, absorbed in prema, wandered for three days in Radha-desha.1

Raga karunashri; disha: "O Lord, O Gora, alas! O Gorachand, alas!"

প্রাতঃকালে উঠি' প্রভু প্রাতঃক্রিয়া করি' ।
'সন্ন্যাস করিব' দঢ়াইল গৌরহরি ॥ ১ ॥

prātaḥkāle uṭhi' prabhu prātaḥkriẏā kari' |
'sannyāsa kariba' daṛhāila gaurahari || 1 ||

pratahkale uthi — rising at dawn; prabhu pratah-kriya kari — the Lord, doing the morning duties; sannyasa kariba — "I shall take sannyasa"; dadhaila gaurahari — Gaurahari resolved

1Rising at dawn and performing His morning duties,
Gaurahari settled His resolve: "I shall take sannyasa."

কণ্টকনগরে আছে ভারতী গোসাঞি ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব তথা পণ্ডিত নিমাই ॥ ২ ॥

kaṇṭakanagare āche bhāratī gosāñi |
sannyāsa kariba tathā paṇḍita nimāi || 2 ||

kantaka-nagare achhe — in Kantakanagara lives; bharati gosani — Bharati Gosani; sannyasa kariba tatha — there will take sannyasa; pandita nimai — Pandita Nimai

2"In Kantakanagara lives Bharati Gosani —
there Pandita Nimai will take sannyasa."2

একান্ত করিয়া মনে কৈল বিশ্বম্ভর ।
যাত্রাকালে লইল দক্ষিণ নাসার স্বর ॥ ৩ ॥

ekānta kariẏā mane kaila biśbambhara |
yātrākāle laila dakṣiṇa nāsāra sbara || 3 ||

ekanta kariya mane — fixing it wholly in His mind; kaila vishvambhara — Vishvambhara resolved; yatra-kale — at setting out; laila dakshina nasara svara — took [as omen] the breath of the right nostril

3Vishvambhara fixed this with all His heart
and, setting out, noted that His breath was flowing through the right nostril.3

চলিলা ত মহাপ্রভু গঙ্গার সমীপে ।
গঙ্গা সাঁতারিয়া গেলা ছাড়ি' নবদ্বীপে ॥ ৪ ॥

calilā ta mahāprabhu gaṅgāra samīpe |
gaṅgā sāṁtāriẏā gelā chāṛi' nabadbīpe || 4 ||

chalila ta mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu went; gangara samipe — to the Ganga; ganga santariya — swimming across the Ganga; gela chhadi navadvipe — went away leaving Navadvipa

4Mahaprabhu went to the Ganga;
swimming across the Ganga, He went away, leaving Navadvipa.4

গঙ্গা নমস্করি' নবদ্বীপ ছাড়ি' যায় ।
বজর পড়িল যেন সভার মাথায় ॥ ৫ ॥

gaṅgā namaskari' nabadbīpa chāṛi' yāẏa |
bajara paṛila yena sabhāra māthāẏa || 5 ||

ganga namaskari — bowing to the Ganga; navadvipa chhadi yaya — He leaves Navadvipa; bajara padila yena — as if a thunderbolt fell; sabhara mathaya — on everyone's head

5Bowing to the Ganga, He leaves Navadvipa —
as if a thunderbolt struck everyone on the head.

কিবা দিন-মাঝে রবি যেন লুকাইল ।
সরোবর ছাড়ি' হংসগণ কোথা গেল ॥ ৬ ॥

kibā dina-mājhe rabi yena lukāila |
sarobara chāṛi' haṃsagaṇa kothā gela || 6 ||

kiba dina-majhe — as if in midday; ravi yena lukaila — the sun hid; sarovara chhadi — leaving the lake; hamsagana kotha gela — where did the swans go

6As if the sun had hidden in the middle of the day,
as if the swans had left the lake — where have they gone?

কিবা দেহ ছাড়ি' প্রাণ গেল আচম্বিতে ।
ভ্রমরা ছাড়িল যেন পদ্মের পিরীতে ॥ ৭ ॥

kibā deha chāṛi' prāṇa gela ācambite |
bhramarā chāṛila yena padmera pirīte || 7 ||

kiba deha chhadi — as if leaving the body; prana gela achambite — life suddenly departed; bhramara chhadila yena — as if the bee forsook; padmera pirite — its love for the lotus

7As if life had suddenly left the body,
as if the bee had forsaken its love for the lotus.

বিচ্ছেদ-বিয়োগময় হৈল নবদ্বীপে ।
শোকের পর্বত যেন সভাকারে চাপে ॥ ৮ ॥

biccheda-biẏogamaẏa haila nabadbīpe |
śokera parbata yena sabhākāre cāpe || 8 ||

vichchheda-viyogamaya — full of the grief of separation; haila navadvipe — Navadvipa became; shokera parvata yena — as if a mountain of sorrow; sabhakare chape — crushes everyone

8Navadvipa was filled with the grief of separation:
a mountain of sorrow seemed to crush everyone.

পরিজন পুরজন শচী বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
মূর্ছিত হইয়া পড়ে অঙ্গ আছাড়িয়া ॥ ৯ ॥

parijana purajana śacī biṣṇupriẏā |
mūrchita haiẏā paṛe aṅga āchāṛiẏā || 9 ||

parijana purajana — household, townsfolk; shachi vishnupriya — Shachi, Vishnupriya; murchhita haiya pade — fall senseless; anga achhadiya — throwing themselves down

9Household and townsfolk, Shachi and Vishnupriya
fall senseless, throwing themselves on the ground.

শচীদেবী কান্দে কোলে করি' বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া ।
বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া মরা যেন রহিল পড়িয়া ॥ ১০ ॥

śacīdebī kānde kole kari' biṣṇupriẏā |
biṣṇupriẏā marā yena rahila paṛiẏā || 10 ||

shachi-devi kande — Shachi-devi weeps; kole kari vishnupriya — holding Vishnupriya on her lap; vishnupriya mara yena — Vishnupriya as if dead; rahila padiya — lies

10Shachi-devi weeps, holding Vishnupriya on her lap —
and Vishnupriya lies as if dead:

অবয়ব আছে — প্রাণ গেল ত ছাড়িয়া ।
শচী-বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া কান্দে ভূমি লোটাইয়া ॥ ১১ ॥

abaẏaba āche — prāṇa gela ta chāṛiẏā |
śacī-biṣṇupriẏā kānde bhūmi loṭāiẏā || 11 ||

avayava achhe — the body is there; prana gela ta chhadiya — life has left it; shachi-vishnupriya kande — Shachi and Vishnupriya weep; bhumi lotaiya — rolling on the ground

11the body is there, but life has left it.
Shachi and Vishnupriya weep, rolling on the ground.

শচীদেবী কান্দে, ডাকে নিমাই বলিয়া ।
আগুনে পুড়িল যেন ধক্ধক্ হিয়া ॥ ১২ ॥

śacīdebī kānde, ḍāke nimāi baliẏā |
āgune puṛila yena dhakdhak hiẏā || 12 ||

shachi-devi kande — Shachi-devi weeps; dake nimai baliya — calls "Nimai!"; agune pudila yena — as if burning in fire; dhakdhak hiya — her blazing heart

12Shachi-devi weeps and calls: "Nimai!" —
her heart blazes as if on fire:

দশদিক্ শূন্য হৈল অন্ধকারময় ।
কেমনে বঞ্চিব মুঞি ঘর ঘোরময় ॥ ১৩ ॥

daśadik śūnya haila andhakāramaẏa |
kemane bañciba muñi ghara ghoramaẏa || 13 ||

dashadik shunya haila — all directions are empty; andhakaramaya — all is darkness; kemane vanchiba munni — how shall I live; ghara ghoramaya — in this dreadful house

13"All around is empty, all is shrouded in darkness —
how shall I live in this dreadful house?

গিলিবারে আইসে মোরে এ ঘরকরণ ।
বিষ যেন লাগে ইষ্ট-কুটুম্ব-বচন ॥ ১৪ ॥

gilibāre āise more e gharakaraṇa |
biṣa yena lāge iṣṭa-kuṭumba-bacana || 14 ||

gilibare aise more — comes to swallow me; e gharakarana — this household; visha yena lage — feel like poison; ishta-kutumba-bachana — the words of friends and kin

14This house comes to swallow me;
the words of friends and kin are like poison.

মা বলিয়া আর মোরে না ডাকিবে কেহ ।
আমারে নাহিক যম — পাশরিল সেহো ॥ ১৫ ॥

mā baliẏā āra more nā ḍākibe keha |
āmāre nāhika yama — pāśarila seho || 15 ||

ma baliya — "mother"; ara more na dakibe keha — no one will call me any more; amare nahika yama — Yama does not take me; pasharila seho — he too has forgotten

15No one will call me 'mother' any more;
even Yama will not take me — he too has forgotten me.

কিবা দুঃখ পাই, পুত্র ছাড়িল আমারে ।
হাপুতি করিয়া মোরে গেলা কোথাকারে ॥ ১৬ ॥

kibā duḥkha pāi, putra chāṛila āmāre |
hāputi kariẏā more gelā kothākāre || 16 ||

kiba duhkha pai — what sorrow I suffer; putra chhadila amare — my son has left me; haputi kariya more — making me bereft of children; gela kothakare — where has he gone

16What sorrow has befallen me — my son has left me!
Making me a mother bereft of children, where has he gone?

হায় হায় নিদারুণ নিমাই হইয়া ।
কোন্ দেশে গেলা, বাছা, কে দিবে আনিয়া ॥ ১৭ ॥

hāẏa hāẏa nidāruṇa nimāi haiẏā |
kon deśe gelā, bāchā, ke dibe āniẏā || 17 ||

haya haya — alas, alas; nidaruna nimai haiya — Nimai, becoming pitiless; kon deshe gela — to what land have you gone; bachha — child; ke dibe aniya — who will bring you back

17Alas, alas, Nimai, you have become pitiless!
To what lands have you gone, my child? Who will bring you back?

বুক ফাটে, বাপ, তোর সোঙরি' মাধুরী ।
মা বলিয়া আর না ডাকিবা গৌরহরি ॥ ১৮ ॥

buka phāṭe, bāpa, tora soṅari' mādhurī |
mā baliẏā āra nā ḍākibā gaurahari || 18 ||

buka phate — my heart breaks; bapa — my son; tora songari madhuri — remembering your sweetness; ma baliya ara na dakiba — you will no more call "mother"; gaurahari — Gaurahari

18My heart breaks, my son, remembering your sweetness:
never again will you call me 'mother', Gaurahari!

অনাথিনী করিয়া কোথা রে গেলে বাপ ।
মনে ছিল — জননীরে দিবে তুমি তাপ ॥ ১৯ ॥

anāthinī kariẏā kothā re gele bāpa |
mane chila — jananīre dibe tumi tāpa || 19 ||

anathini kariya — making me helpless; kotha re gele bapa — where have you gone, son; mane chhila — it was in your mind; jananire dibe tumi tapa — to give your mother pain

19Leaving me helpless, where have you gone, my son?
It must have been in your mind to give your mother pain.

পড়িয়া শুনিঞা পুত্র ইহাই শিখিলা ।
অনাথিনী অভাগিনী মায়েরে করিলা ॥ ২০ ॥

paṛiẏā śuniñā putra ihāi śikhilā |
anāthinī abhāginī māẏere karilā || 20 ||

padiya shuniya — studying and hearing; putra ihai shikhila — the son learned this; anathini abhagini — helpless, wretched; mayere karila — he made his mother

20You studied, you heard [the scriptures], my son — and this is what you learned:
to make your mother helpless and wretched!

কোথা বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া এড়ি' পলাইয়া গেলা ।
ভকত-সভার প্রেম কিছু না গণিলা ॥ ২১ ॥

kothā biṣṇupriẏā eṛi' palāiẏā gelā |
bhakata-sabhāra prema kichu nā gaṇilā || 21 ||

kotha — where; vishnupriya edi — abandoning Vishnupriya; palaiya gela — have you fled; bhakata-sabhara prema — the love of all the devotees; kichhu na ganila — counted as nothing

21Where have you fled, abandoning Vishnupriya?
The love of all the devotees you counted as nothing!"

বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়া কান্দে, হিয়া নাহিক সম্বিত ।
ক্ষণে উঠে, ক্ষণে পড়ে — উনমত চিত ॥ ২২ ॥

biṣṇupriẏā kānde, hiẏā nāhika sambita |
kṣaṇe uṭhe, kṣaṇe paṛe — unamata cita || 22 ||

vishnupriya kande — Vishnupriya weeps; hiya nahika samvita — her heart is senseless; kshane uthe kshane pade — now rises, now falls; unamata chita — her mind distracted

22Vishnupriya weeps, her heart senseless;
now she rises, now she falls — her mind distracted.

বসন না দেয় গায়ে, না বান্ধয়ে চুলি ।
হাকান্দ কান্দন কান্দে উনমতি পাগলী ॥ ২৩ ॥

basana nā deẏa gāẏe, nā bāndhaẏe culi |
hākānda kāndana kānde unamati pāgalī || 23 ||

vasana na deya gaye — puts no cloth on her body; na bandhaye chuli — does not bind her hair; hakanda kandana kande — sobs aloud; unamati pagali — like a madwoman

23She puts on no clothes, does not bind her hair,
she sobs aloud like a madwoman.

প্রভুর অঙ্গের মালা হৃদয়ে করিয়া ।
জ্বালহ আগুনি, তাথে মরিব পুড়িয়া ॥ ২৪ ॥

prabhura aṅgera mālā hṛdaẏe kariẏā |
jbālaha āguni, tāthe mariba puṛiẏā || 24 ||

prabhura angera mala — the garland from the Lord's body; hridaye kariya — holding to her bosom; jvalaha aguni — light a fire; tathe mariba pudiya — I shall burn in it and die

24Pressing to her bosom the garland from the Lord's body, [she says]:
"Light a fire — I shall burn in it and die."

গুণ বিনাইতে নারে — মরয়ে মরমে ।
সবে এক বোল বোলে — যে ছিল করমে ॥ ২৫ ॥

guṇa bināite nāre — maraẏe marame |
sabe eka bola bole — ye chila karame || 25 ||

guna vinaite nare — cannot recount His qualities; maraye marame — dies within; sabe eka bola bole — says only one thing; ye chhila karame — what was in my karma

25She cannot recount His qualities — she dies in the depths of her soul
and repeats only one thing: "What was in my fate [has come to pass]."

অমিয়া-অধিক প্রভু তোর যত গুণ ।
এখনে সকল সেই ভৈ গেল আগুন ॥ ২৬ ॥

amiẏā-adhika prabhu tora yata guṇa |
ekhane sakala sei bhai gela āguna || 26 ||

amiya-adhika — sweeter than nectar; prabhu tora yata guna — Lord, all Your qualities; ekhane sakala sei — now all that; bhai gela aguna — has turned to fire

26"Lord, all Your qualities are sweeter than nectar —
and now all of it has turned to fire."

রহস্য-বিনোদ-কথা কহিবারে নারে ।
হিয়ার পোড়নে কান্দে অতি-আর্ত-স্বরে ॥ ২৭ ॥

rahasya-binoda-kathā kahibāre nāre |
hiẏāra poṛane kānde ati-ārta-sbare || 27 ||

rahasya-vinoda-katha — of intimate joys; kahibare nare — she cannot speak; hiyara podane kande — weeps from the burning of her heart; ati-arta-svare — in a most piteous voice

27Of their intimate joys she cannot even speak —
her heart burns, and she weeps in a piercing voice.

চৌদিগে ভকত মরে অন্তর-যন্ত্রণা ।
কি কহিব — সম্বরিতে না পারে আপনা ॥ ২৮ ॥

caudige bhakata mare antara-yantraṇā |
ki kahiba — sambarite nā pāre āpanā || 28 ||

chaudige bhakata mare — around her the devotees are dying; antara-yantrana — of inner anguish; ki kahiba — what shall I say; sambarite na pare apana — they cannot restrain themselves

28Around her the devotees are dying of anguish within —
what can be said? they cannot restrain themselves.

অনেক শকতি সভে বোলে ধীরে ধীরে ।
কি দিব প্রবোধ তোরে — প্রাণ কর স্থিরে ॥ ২৯ ॥

aneka śakati sabhe bole dhīre dhīre |
ki diba prabodha tore — prāṇa kara sthire || 29 ||

aneka shakati — with great effort; sabhe bole dhire dhire — all speak softly; ki diba prabodha tore — what consolation can we give you; prana kara sthire — steady your life

29Gathering all their strength, they say to her softly, softly:
"How can we console you? Steady your life.

যে দেখিলে যে শুনিলে এতকাল ধরি' ।
প্রাণ স্থির কর সেই সব মনে করি' ॥ ৩০ ॥

ye dekhile ye śunile etakāla dhari' |
prāṇa sthira kara sei saba mane kari' || 30 ||

ye dekhile ye shunile — what you saw and heard; etakala dhari — all this time; prana sthira kara — steady your life; sei saba mane kari — remembering all that

30What you have seen, what you have heard all this time —
remember all that and steady your life.

কি জানহ — ভগবান্ কার আপনার ।
শুনিয়াছ যত যত পূর্ব অবতার ॥ ৩১ ॥

ki jānaha — bhagabān kāra āpanāra |
śuniẏācha yata yata pūrba abatāra || 31 ||

ki janaha — do you know; bhagavan kara apanara — whose own Bhagavan is; shuniyachha — you have heard; yata yata purva avatara — of all the former avataras

31Do you know whose He is — Bhagavan?
You have heard of all the former avataras.

লোক-বেদ-অগোচর চরিত্র তাঁহার ।
বড় ভাগ্যে নাম ধর সম্বন্ধ তোমার ॥ ৩২ ॥

loka-beda-agocara caritra tāṁhāra |
baṛa bhāgye nāma dhara sambandha tomāra || 32 ||

loka-veda-agochara — beyond the world and the Vedas; charitra tanhara — are His deeds; bada bhagye — by great fortune; nama dhara sambandha tomara — you bear the name of His kin

32His deeds are beyond the reach of the world and the Vedas;
by great fortune you bear the name of His kin.

যারে যেই আজ্ঞা কৈলা — থাক সেইমতে ।
সেই আজ্ঞা পালন করহ দৃঢ়চিতে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

yāre yei ājñā kailā — thāka seimate |
sei ājñā pālana karaha dṛṛhacite || 33 ||

yare yei ajna kaila — whatever He bade each; thaka seimate — live accordingly; sei ajna palana karaha — carry out that command; dridha-chite — with a firm heart

33Whatever He commanded each of us — so let us live:
carry out that command with a firm heart."

এতেক বচন যবে বৈল ভক্তগণ ।
শুনিঞা কাতর হিয়া সম্বরে ক্রন্দন ॥ ৩৪ ॥

eteka bacana yabe baila bhaktagaṇa |
śuniñā kātara hiẏā sambare krandana || 34 ||

eteka bachana yabe — when such words; vaila bhaktagana — the devotees spoke; shuniña katara hiya — hearing, aching at heart; sambare krandana — she holds back her weeping

34When the devotees spoke such words,
she listened and, aching at heart, held back her weeping.

তবে নিত্যানন্দ লঞা সব ভক্তগণ ।
যুক্তি করে — কোথা গেলে পাব দরশন ॥ ৩৫ ॥

tabe nityānanda lañā saba bhaktagaṇa |
yukti kare — kothā gele pāba daraśana || 35 ||

tabe nityananda — then Nityananda; lana saba bhaktagana — with all the devotees; yukti kare — takes counsel; kotha gele paba darashana — where shall we go to see Him

35Then Nityananda, gathering all the devotees,
takes counsel: "Where shall we go to see Him?"

কেহো বোলে — যত তীর্থ করিব গমন ।
যথা গেলে গোরাচাঁদের পাব দরশন ॥ ৩৬ ॥

keho bole — yata tīrtha kariba gamana |
yathā gele gorācāṁdera pāba daraśana || 36 ||

keho bole — someone says; yata tirtha kariba gamana — we shall go to all the holy places; yatha gele — going wherever; gorachandera paba darashana — we shall see Gorachand

36Someone says: "Let us go round all the holy places —
somewhere we shall see Gorachand."

কেহো বোলে — বৃন্দাবন যাব বারাণসী ।
নীলাচলে যাব যথা থাকয়ে সন্ন্যাসী ॥ ৩৭ ॥

keho bole — bṛndābana yāba bārāṇasī |
nīlācale yāba yathā thākaẏe sannyāsī || 37 ||

keho bole — someone says; vrindavana yaba varanasi — we shall go to Vrindavana, Varanasi; nilachale yaba — we shall go to Nilachala; yatha thakaye sannyasi — where sannyasis live

37Someone says: "Let us go to Vrindavana, to Varanasi,
let us go to Nilachala, where the sannyasis live."

কাঞ্চননগরে আছে ভারতী গোসাঞি ।
সন্ন্যাস করিব তথা পণ্ডিত নিমাই ॥ ৩৮ ॥

kāñcananagare āche bhāratī gosāñi |
sannyāsa kariba tathā paṇḍita nimāi || 38 ||

kanchana-nagare achhe — in Kanchananagara lives; bharati gosani — Bharati Gosani; sannyasa kariba tatha — there will take sannyasa; pandita nimai — Pandita Nimai

38[Nityananda says:] "In Kanchananagara lives Bharati Gosani —
there Pandita Nimai will take sannyasa.

এই বাক্য কভু প্রভুর মুখে শুনিয়াছি ।
সত্য করি' এই বাক্য দৃঢ় নাহি বুঝি ॥ ৩৯ ॥

ei bākya kabhu prabhura mukhe śuniẏāchi |
satya kari' ei bākya dṛṛha nāhi bujhi || 39 ||

ei vakya kabhu — these words once; prabhura mukhe shuniyachhi — I heard from the Lord's lips; satya kari — as true; ei vakya dridha nahi bujhi — I am not sure of them

39These words I once heard from the Lord's lips,
but I am not sure they are true.

মিথ্যা-বাক্যে সব লোক ধাইবে তথারে ।
আগে আমি তত্ত্ব জানি' কহিব সভারে ॥ ৪০ ॥

mithyā-bākye saba loka dhāibe tathāre |
āge āmi tattba jāni' kahiba sabhāre || 40 ||

mithya-vakye — on a false report; saba loka dhaibe tathare — everyone will rush there; age ami tattva jani — first I, learning the truth; kahiba sabhare — shall tell all

40If on a false report everyone rushes there, [it will be bad];
first I shall learn the truth and tell everyone.

ধীর ভক্তজন কথো দেহ মোর সঙ্গে ।
ধরিয়া আনিব মোর প্রভু সে গৌরাঙ্গে ॥ ৪১ ॥

dhīra bhaktajana katho deha mora saṅge |
dhariẏā āniba mora prabhu se gaurāṅge || 41 ||

dhira bhaktajana katho — a few steadfast devotees; deha mora sange — give me as companions; dhariya aniba — I shall seize and bring back; mora prabhu se gaurange — my Lord Gauranga

41Give me a few steadfast devotees to go with me —
I shall seize my Lord Gauranga and bring Him back."

তবে সব ভক্তগণ মনে অনুমানে ।
মুখ্য মুখ্য জন কথো দিল তাঁর সনে ॥ ৪২ ॥

tabe saba bhaktagaṇa mane anumāne |
mukhya mukhya jana katho dila tāṁra sane || 42 ||

tabe saba bhaktagana — then all the devotees; mane anumane — considering; mukhya mukhya jana katho — several of the foremost; dila tanra sane — gave to go with Him

42Then all the devotees, considering,
gave Him several of the foremost as companions.

শ্রীচন্দ্রশেখরাচার্য, পণ্ডিত দামোদর ।
বক্রেশ্বর-আদি করি' চলিলা সত্বর ॥ ৪৩ ॥

śrīcandraśekharācārya, paṇḍita dāmodara |
bakreśbara-ādi kari' calilā satbara || 43 ||

sri-chandrashekharacharya — Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya; pandita damodara — Pandita Damodara; vakreshvara-adi kari — Vakreshvara and others; chalila satvara — set out in haste

43Sri Chandrashekhara Acharya, Pandita Damodara,
Vakreshvara and others set out in haste.

এই সব লঞা নিত্যানন্দ চলি' যায় ।
প্রবোধিয়া শচী-বিষ্ণুপ্রিয়ার হৃদয় ॥ ৪৪ ॥

ei saba lañā nityānanda cali' yāẏa |
prabodhiẏā śacī-biṣṇupriẏāra hṛdaẏa || 44 ||

ei saba lana — taking them; nityananda chali yaya — Nityananda goes; prabodhiya — having consoled; shachi-vishnupriyara hridaya — the hearts of Shachi and Vishnupriya

44With them Nityananda departs,
having consoled the hearts of Shachi and Vishnupriya.

এথা গৌরহরি শীঘ্র চলিলা সত্বর ।
কোটি-কুঞ্জর মত্ত গমন সুন্দর ॥ ৪৫ ॥

ethā gaurahari śīghra calilā satbara |
koṭi-kuñjara matta gamana sundara || 45 ||

etha gaurahari — meanwhile Gaurahari; shighra chalila satvara — went on swiftly; koti-kunjara matta — [like] a myriad maddened elephants; gamana sundara — with beautiful gait

45Meanwhile Gaurahari pressed swiftly on
with a beautiful gait, like a myriad maddened elephants.

ঝর ঝর নয়নে ঝরয়ে প্রেমধারা ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ সোণার কিশোরা ॥ ৪৬ ॥

jhara jhara naẏane jharaẏe premadhārā |
pulake ākula aṅga soṇāra kiśorā || 46 ||

jhara jhara nayane — from the eyes stream; jharaye prema-dhara — torrents of prema; pulake akula anga — the body thrilling; sonara kishora — of the golden youth

46Streams of prema pour from His eyes,
the golden youth's body thrills, its hairs on end.

ঊর্ধ্ববাসে কেশ প্রভু করিয়া বন্ধন ।
মথুরার মল্ল যেন করিবে গমন ॥ ৪৭ ॥

ūrdhbabāse keśa prabhu kariẏā bandhana |
mathurāra malla yena karibe gamana || 47 ||

urdhva-vase — with His upper cloth; kesha prabhu kariya bandhana — the Lord binding His hair; mathurara malla — to the wrestlers of Mathura; yena karibe gamana — as if going

47Binding His hair with His upper cloth, the Lord
[goes] as if [Krishna] to fight the wrestlers of Mathura.5

রাধার বিরহ-ভাবে হইয়া আকুল ।
কোথা রাধা, গেল মোর কোথায় গোকুল ॥ ৪৮ ॥

rādhāra biraha-bhābe haiẏā ākula |
kothā rādhā, gela mora kothāẏa gokula || 48 ||

radhara viraha-bhave — in the bhava of separation from Radha; haiya akula — overwhelmed; kotha radha — where is Radha; gela mora kothaya gokula — where has my Gokula gone

48Overwhelmed by the bhava of separation from Radha, [He cries]:
"Where is Radha? Where has my Gokula gone?"6

সে গমন ক্ষণে ক্ষণে মন্থর হইয়া ।
মালসাট মারে ক্ষণে চৌদিগে চাহিয়া ॥ ৪৯ ॥

se gamana kṣaṇe kṣaṇe manthara haiẏā |
mālasāṭa māre kṣaṇe caudige cāhiẏā || 49 ||

se gamana — that gait; kshane kshane manthara haiya — now and then slowing; malasata mare kshane — now He slaps His arms; chaudige chahiya — looking around

49Now His pace slows,
now He slaps His arms, looking around on all sides.

এইমতে প্রেমাবেশে চলি' যায় পথে ।
অখিলের গুরু মোর প্রভু জগন্নাথে ॥ ৫০ ॥

eimate premābeśe cali' yāẏa pathe |
akhilera guru mora prabhu jagannāthe || 50 ||

eimate premaveshe — thus, absorbed in prema; chali yaya pathe — goes along the road; akhilera guru — the guru of all; mora prabhu jagannathe — my Lord Jagannatha

50Thus, absorbed in prema, goes along the road
my Lord Jagannatha, the guru of all.

কাঞ্চননগরে আইলা প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর ।
যথা আছে কেশব-ভারতী ন্যাসিবর ॥ ৫১ ॥

kāñcananagare āilā prabhu biśbambhara |
yathā āche keśaba-bhāratī nyāsibara || 51 ||

kanchana-nagare aila — came to Kanchananagara; prabhu vishvambhara — the Lord Vishvambhara; yatha achhe — where lives; keshava-bharati nyasivara — Keshava Bharati, best of sannyasis

51The Lord Vishvambhara came to Kanchananagara,
where lived Keshava Bharati, the best of sannyasis.

পরম ভকতি করি' প্রণাম করে ।
উঠিয়া সম্ভ্রমে ন্যাসী নারায়ণ স্মরে ॥ ৫২ ॥

parama bhakati kari' praṇāma kare |
uṭhiẏā sambhrame nyāsī nārāẏaṇa smare || 52 ||

parama bhakati kari — with highest devotion; pranama kare — He bows; uthiya sambhrame — rising respectfully; nyasi narayana smare — the sannyasi utters "Narayana"

52With the highest devotion He bows [to him],
and the sannyasi, rising respectfully, utters: "Narayana!"7

বড় ভাগ্য মানি' দোঁহে সরস সম্ভাষ ।
বিশ্বম্ভর বোলে — মোরে করাহ সন্ন্যাস ॥ ৫৩ ॥

baṛa bhāgya māni' doṁhe sarasa sambhāṣa |
biśbambhara bole — more karāha sannyāsa || 53 ||

bada bhagya mani — deeming it great fortune; donhe sarasa sambhasha — both converse warmly; vishvambhara bole — Vishvambhara says; more karaha sannyasa — give Me sannyasa

53Both deem [the meeting] great good fortune and converse warmly;
Vishvambhara says: "Give Me sannyasa."

এইমনে দুইজনে আছে এককালে ।
আইলা নিত্যানন্দ চন্দ্রশেখরাদি-মেলে ॥ ৫৪ ॥

eimane duijane āche ekakāle |
āilā nityānanda candraśekharādi-mele || 54 ||

eimane duijane achhe — while the two were thus; eka-kale — at that time; aila nityananda — Nityananda came; chandrashekharadi-mele — with Chandrashekhara and others

54While the two were thus together,
Nityananda arrived with Chandrashekhara and the others.

সন্ন্যাসীকে নমস্করি' প্রভু নমস্করে ।
হাসিয়া কহয়ে প্রভু — ভাল হৈল আইলে ॥ ৫৫ ॥

sannyāsīke namaskari' prabhu namaskare |
hāsiẏā kahaẏe prabhu — bhāla haila āile || 55 ||

sannyasike namaskari — bowing to the sannyasi; prabhu namaskare — they bow to the Lord; hasiya kahaye prabhu — the Lord says smiling; bhala haila aile — it is good you came

55Bowing to the sannyasi, they bow to the Lord;
the Lord, smiling, says: "It is good that you have come.

তোমার গমনে মোর সকলি মঙ্গল ।
সন্ন্যাস হইব, মোর জনম সফল ॥ ৫৬ ॥

tomāra gamane mora sakali maṅgala |
sannyāsa haiba, mora janama saphala || 56 ||

tomara gamane — with your coming; mora sakali mangala — all is auspicious for Me; sannyasa haiba — I shall take sannyasa; mora janama saphala — My life will be fulfilled

56With your coming all is auspicious for Me:
I shall take sannyasa — and My life will be fulfilled."

এ বোল বলিয়া পুনঃ ভারতী সম্ভাষে ।
প্রণতি মিনতি করে সন্ন্যাসের আশে ॥ ৫৭ ॥

e bola baliẏā punaḥ bhāratī sambhāṣe |
praṇati minati kare sannyāsera āśe || 57 ||

e bola baliya — saying this; punah bharati sambhashe — again addresses Bharati; pranati minati kare — bows and pleads; sannyasera ashe — hoping for sannyasa

57Saying this, He again addresses Bharati,
bowing and pleading for sannyasa.

ভারতী কহয়ে — শুন শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তোমারে সন্ন্যাস দিতে কাঁপয়ে অন্তর ॥ ৫৮ ॥

bhāratī kahaẏe — śuna śuna biśbambhara |
tomāre sannyāsa dite kāṁpaẏe antara || 58 ||

bharati kahaye — Bharati says; shuna shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; tomare sannyasa dite — to give You sannyasa; kanpaye antara — my heart trembles

58Bharati says: "Listen, listen, Vishvambhara:
my heart trembles at giving You sannyasa.

এহেন সুন্দর তনু, তরুণ বয়স ।
জনম অবধি নাহি জান দুঃখ-ক্লেশ ॥ ৫৯ ॥

ehena sundara tanu, taruṇa baẏasa |
janama abadhi nāhi jāna duḥkha-kleśa || 59 ||

ehena sundara tanu — such a lovely body; taruna bayasa — young age; janama avadhi — since birth; nahi jana duhkha-klesha — You have known no sorrow or hardship

59Such a beautiful body, such young years —
since birth You have known no sorrow or hardship.

অপত্য-সন্ততি নাহি হয়ে ত তোমার ।
তোমারে সন্ন্যাস দিতে না হয় আমার ॥ ৬০ ॥

apatya-santati nāhi haẏe ta tomāra |
tomāre sannyāsa dite nā haẏa āmāra || 60 ||

apatya-santati — offspring; nahi haye ta tomara — You do not have; tomare sannyasa dite — to give You sannyasa; na haya amara — is not for me

60You do not even have offspring —
it is not for me to give You sannyasa.

পঞ্চাশের ঊর্ধ্ব হৈলে রাগের নিবৃত্তি ।
তবে সে সন্ন্যাস দিতে তোরে হয় যুক্তি ॥ ৬১ ॥

pañcāśera ūrdhba haile rāgera nibṛtti |
tabe se sannyāsa dite tore haẏa yukti || 61 ||

panchashera urdhva haile — when past fifty; ragera nivritti — passions subside; tabe se sannyasa dite — then to give sannyasa; tore haya yukti — to You is reasonable

61When You are past fifty and the passions subside,
then it will be reasonable to give You sannyasa."8

এ বোল শুনিঞা প্রভু কহে লহু বাণী ।
তোমার সাক্ষাতে আমি কি বলিতে জানি ॥ ৬২ ॥

e bola śuniñā prabhu kahe lahu bāṇī |
tomāra sākṣāte āmi ki balite jāni || 62 ||

e bola shuniña — hearing this; prabhu kahe lahu vani — the Lord speaks softly; tomara sakshate — in your presence; ami ki balite jani — what can I say

62Hearing this, the Lord says softly:
"What can I say in your presence?

মায়া না করিহ মোরে, শুন ন্যাসিমণি ।
ধর্মাধর্ম-তত্ত্ব কেবা জানে তোমা বিনি ॥ ৬৩ ॥

māẏā nā kariha more, śuna nyāsimaṇi |
dharmādharma-tattba kebā jāne tomā bini || 63 ||

maya na kariha more — do not dissemble with Me; shuna nyasimani — listen, jewel of sannyasis; dharmadharma-tattva — the truth of dharma and adharma; keba jane toma vini — who knows but you

63Do not dissemble with Me, jewel among sannyasis:9
who but you knows the truth of dharma and adharma?

সংসারে দুর্লভ এই মানুষের জন্ম ।
তাহাতে দুর্লভ কৃষ্ণভক্তি পরধর্ম ॥ ৬৪ ॥

saṃsāre durlabha ei mānuṣera janma |
tāhāte durlabha kṛṣṇabhakti paradharma || 64 ||

samsare durlabha — rare in samsara; ei manushera janma — is this human birth; tahate durlabha — rare in it; krishna-bhakti paradharma — devotion to Krishna, the highest dharma

64In samsara this birth as a human being is rare,
and in it rare is devotion to Krishna, the highest dharma.

বড়ই দুর্লভ তাহে ভক্তজন-সঙ্গ ।
মানুষের এ দেহ তিলেকে হয় ভঙ্গ ॥ ৬৫ ॥

baṛai durlabha tāhe bhaktajana-saṅga |
mānuṣera e deha tileke haẏa bhaṅga || 65 ||

badai durlabha tahe — rarer still in it; bhaktajana-sanga — the company of devotees; manushera e deha — this human body; tileke haya bhanga — perishes in a moment

65And rarer still the company of devotees;
and the human body perishes in a moment.

বিলম্ব করিতে এই দেহ যায় যবে ।
তবে আর বৈষ্ণবের সঙ্গ হবে কবে ॥ ৬৬ ॥

bilamba karite ei deha yāẏa yabe |
tabe āra baiṣṇabera saṅga habe kabe || 66 ||

vilamba karite — while delaying; ei deha yaya yabe — if this body passes; tabe ara — then again; vaishnavera sanga habe kabe — when will there be the company of Vaishnavas

66If, while I delay, this body passes away —
when then shall I have the company of Vaishnavas?

মায়া না করিহ মোরে, করাহ সন্ন্যাস ।
তোর পরসাদে মুঞি হঙ কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ৬৭ ॥

māẏā nā kariha more, karāha sannyāsa |
tora parasāde muñi haṅa kṛṣṇadāsa || 67 ||

maya na kariha more — do not dissemble with Me; karaha sannyasa — give sannyasa; tora parasade — by your grace; munni hana krishnadasa — may I become Krishna's servant

67Do not dissemble with Me — give Me sannyasa:
by your grace may I become a servant of Krishna."

ইহা বলি' করুণ-অরুণ দু-নয়ান ।
ছল ছল করে অশ্রু, কাতর বয়ান ॥ ৬৮ ॥

ihā bali' karuṇa-aruṇa du-naẏāna |
chala chala kare aśru, kātara baẏāna || 68 ||

iha bali — saying this; karuna-aruna du-nayana — His merciful eyes reddened; chhala chhala kare ashru — brimming with tears; katara bayana — His face anguished

68Saying this, [He stands]: His merciful eyes reddened,
brimming with tears, His face full of anguish.

হুঙ্কার-গর্জন সিংহ জিনি' পরাক্রম ।
ভাবময় সব দেহ অতি সুলক্ষণ ॥ ৬৯ ॥

huṅkāra-garjana siṃha jini' parākrama |
bhābamaẏa saba deha ati sulakṣaṇa || 69 ||

hunkara-garjana — roaring; simha jini parakrama — surpassing a lion in might; bhavamaya saba deha — His whole body full of bhava; ati sulakshana — most auspiciously marked

69Roaring, He surpasses a lion in might;
His whole body is bhava itself, marked with every auspicious sign.

হরি হরি বলি' ডাকে মেঘের গর্জনে ।
অবিরাম প্রেমবারি ঝরে দু-নয়নে ॥ ৭০ ॥

hari hari bali' ḍāke meghera garjane |
abirāma premabāri jhare du-naẏane || 70 ||

hari hari bali dake — He calls "Hari, Hari"; meghera garjane — with the thunder of a cloud; avirama prema-vari — ceaselessly tears of prema; jhare du-nayane — flow from His eyes

70"Hari, Hari!" He calls with the thunder of a cloud,
tears of prema flow ceaselessly from His eyes.

ত্রিভঙ্গ হইয়া 'বংশী বংশী' বলি' ডাকে ।
ক্ষণে 'রাসমণ্ডলী' বলিয়া অঙ্গ বাঁকে ॥ ৭১ ॥

tribhaṅga haiẏā 'baṃśī baṃśī' bali' ḍāke |
kṣaṇe 'rāsamaṇḍalī' baliẏā aṅga bāṁke || 71 ||

tribhanga haiya — standing thrice-bent; vamshi vamshi bali dake — calls "flute, flute"; kshane rasamandali baliya — now, saying "circle of the rasa"; anga banke — bends His body

71Standing thrice-bent, He calls: "The flute, the flute!";
now, crying "The circle of the rasa!", He bends His body.

গোবর্ধন, রাধাকুণ্ড বলি' ডাকে হাসে ।
চমৎকার হৈল ন্যাসী অন্তর-তরাসে ॥ ৭২ ॥

gobardhana, rādhākuṇḍa bali' ḍāke hāse |
camatkāra haila nyāsī antara-tarāse || 72 ||

govardhana radhakunda bali — saying "Govardhana, Radha-kunda"; dake hase — He calls and laughs; chamatkara haila nyasi — the sannyasi was astonished; antara-tarase — trembling at heart

72He calls "Govardhana! Radha-kunda!" and laughs;
the sannyasi was astonished, trembling at heart.

অন্তরে চিন্তিয়া কিছু বোলে ন্যাসিরাজ ।
অন্তরে জানিল — মোর ভাল নহে কাজ ॥ ৭৩ ॥

antare cintiẏā kichu bole nyāsirāja |
antare jānila — mora bhāla nahe kāja || 73 ||

antare chintiya — reflecting; kichhu bole nyasiraja — the king of sannyasis speaks; antare janila — understood within; mora bhala nahe kaja — this is not a good deed for me

73Reflecting in his heart, the king of sannyasis speaks —
he understood within: "This is not a good deed for me.

জগতের গুরু এই জগতের নাথ ।
'গুরু' বলি' আমারে করিবে জোড়-হাত ॥ ৭৪ ॥

jagatera guru ei jagatera nātha |
'guru' bali' āmāre karibe joṛa-hāta || 74 ||

jagatera guru ei — He is the guru of the world; jagatera natha — the Lord of the world; guru bali — calling me guru; amare karibe joda-hata — will join His palms to me

74He is the guru of the world, the Lord of the world —
and He will bow to me with joined palms, calling me guru."

এত অনুমানি' ন্যাসী কহিল উত্তর ।
সন্ন্যাস করিবে যদি, যাহ নিজ-ঘর ॥ ৭৫ ॥

eta anumāni' nyāsī kahila uttara |
sannyāsa karibe yadi, yāha nija-ghara || 75 ||

eta anumani — reasoning thus; nyasi kahila uttara — the sannyasi answered; sannyasa karibe yadi — if You will take sannyasa; yaha nija-ghara — go home

75Reasoning thus, the sannyasi answered:
"If You want to take sannyasa, go home.

সাক্ষাতে জননী-ঠাঞি হইবে বিদায় ।
তোর পত্নী সুচরিতা — যাবে তার ঠাঁয় ॥ ৭৬ ॥

sākṣāte jananī-ṭhāñi haibe bidāẏa |
tora patnī sucaritā — yābe tāra ṭhāṁẏa || 76 ||

sakshate — in person; janani-thani haibe vidaya — take leave of Your mother; tora patni sucharita — Your virtuous wife; yabe tara thanya — go to her

76Take leave of Your mother in person;
and Your virtuous wife — go to her.

সাক্ষাতে সভার ঠাঞি বিদায় হইয়া ।
আসিবে আমার ঠাঁই সভারে বুঝাঞা ॥ ৭৭ ॥

sākṣāte sabhāra ṭhāñi bidāẏa haiẏā |
āsibe āmāra ṭhāṁi sabhāre bujhāñā || 77 ||

sakshate sabhara thani — in person with everyone; vidaya haiya — taking leave; asibe amara thai — come to me; sabhare bujhaña — making everyone understand

77Having taken leave of everyone in person
and made everyone understand, come to me."

মনে আছে — গোরাচাঁদে করিয়া বিদায় ।
আসন ছাড়িয়া আমি যাব অন্য ঠাঁয় ॥ ৭৮ ॥

mane āche — gorācāṁde kariẏā bidāẏa |
āsana chāṛiẏā āmi yāba anya ṭhāṁẏa || 78 ||

mane achhe — in his mind; gorachande kariya vidaya — having sent Gorachand away; asana chhadiya — leaving my seat; ami yaba anya thanya — I shall go elsewhere

78But in his mind: "Having sent Gorachand away,
I shall leave my seat and go elsewhere."

অন্তর্যামী ভগবান্ এ মন জানিঞা ।
পালিব তোমার আজ্ঞা, বলিল হাসিয়া ॥ ৭৯ ॥

antaryāmī bhagabān e mana jāniñā |
pāliba tomāra ājñā, balila hāsiẏā || 79 ||

antaryami bhagavan — Bhagavan, the Knower of hearts; e mana janiña — knowing this intention; paliba tomara ajna — I shall carry out your command; balila hasiya — said smiling

79Bhagavan, the Knower of hearts, understood this intention
and said with a smile: "I shall carry out your command."

চলিলেন মহাপ্রভু নবদ্বীপ-পুরে ।
দেখিয়া ভাবিল ন্যাসী আপন অন্তরে ॥ ৮০ ॥

calilena mahāprabhu nabadbīpa-pure |
dekhiẏā bhābila nyāsī āpana antare || 80 ||

chalilena mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu set out; navadvipa-pure — for Navadvipa; dekhiya bhavila nyasi — seeing this, the sannyasi thought; apana antare — to himself

80Mahaprabhu set out for Navadvipa;
watching Him, the sannyasi thought to himself:

যাঁর লোমকূপে ব্রহ্মাণ্ডের গণ বৈসে ।
তাঁরে পলাইয়া আমি যাব কোন্ দেশে ॥ ৮১ ॥

yāṁra lomakūpe brahmāṇḍera gaṇa baise |
tāṁre palāiẏā āmi yāba kon deśe || 81 ||

yanra lomakupe — in whose pores; brahmandera gana vaise — hosts of universes dwell; tanre palaiya — fleeing from Him; ami yaba kon deshe — to what land shall I go

81"He in whose pores hosts of universes dwell —
where, to what land, shall I flee from Him?

ভ্রান্তমতি আমি কিছু দেখিয়া না দেখি ।
সভার জীবন এই, সর্বজন-সাখী ॥ ৮২ ॥

bhrāntamati āmi kichu dekhiẏā nā dekhi |
sabhāra jībana ei, sarbajana-sākhī || 82 ||

bhrantamati ami — I, deluded; kichhu dekhiya na dekhi — look and do not see; sabhara jivana ei — He is the life of all; sarvajana-sakhi — the witness of all

82Deluded in mind, I look and do not see:
He is the life of all, the witness of all."

ইহা ভাবি' সন্ন্যাসী ডাকিয়া গৌরহরি ।
বলিতে লাগিল কিছু অনুনয় করি' ॥ ৮৩ ॥

ihā bhābi' sannyāsī ḍākiẏā gaurahari |
balite lāgila kichu anunaẏa kari' || 83 ||

iha bhavi — thinking thus; sannyasi dakiya gaurahari — the sannyasi, calling Gaurahari; balite lagila kichhu — began to speak; anunaya kari — entreating

83Thinking thus, the sannyasi called Gaurahari
and began to speak, entreating Him:

আর এক বোল বোলোঁ, শুন বিশ্বম্ভর ।
তোমারে সন্ন্যাস দিতে বড় লাগে ডর ॥ ৮৪ ॥

āra eka bola boloṁ, śuna biśbambhara |
tomāre sannyāsa dite baṛa lāge ḍara || 84 ||

ara eka bola bolon — I shall say one more word; shuna vishvambhara — listen, Vishvambhara; tomare sannyasa dite — to give You sannyasa; bada lage dara — I am much afraid

84"I shall say one more word, listen, Vishvambhara:
I am very much afraid to give You sannyasa.

তুমি জগতের গুরু — কে গুরু তোমার ।
মিছা বিড়ম্বনা কেনে করহ আমার ॥ ৮৫ ॥

tumi jagatera guru — ke guru tomāra |
michā biṛambanā kene karaha āmāra || 85 ||

tumi jagatera guru — You are the guru of the world; ke guru tomara — who is Your guru; michha vidambana — a needless embarrassment; kene karaha amara — why do You make for me

85You are the guru of the world: who is Your guru?
Why do You needlessly put me in a false position?"

এ বোল শুনিয়া কান্দে বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
আরতি করিয়া ধরে সন্ন্যাসীর পায় ॥ ৮৬ ॥

e bola śuniẏā kānde biśbambhara rāẏa |
ārati kariẏā dhare sannyāsīra pāẏa || 86 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; kande vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya weeps; arati kariya — in longing; dhare sannyasira paya — clasps the sannyasi's feet

86Hearing this, Vishvambhara Raya wept
and in longing clasped the sannyasi's feet:

প্রণত-জনেরে কেনে বোল দুর্বচন ।
মরিলে কি ছাড়ি আমি তোমার চরণ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

praṇata-janere kene bola durbacana |
marile ki chāṛi āmi tomāra caraṇa || 87 ||

pranata-janere — to one who bows down; kene bola durbachana — why do you speak harsh words; marile ki chhadi ami — even dying would I leave; tomara charana — your feet

87"Why do you speak harsh words to one who bows before you?
Even dying I shall not let go of your feet.

মোরে যত বোল — মোর বুঝিবার মন ।
এক নিবেদন আছে — শুনহ বচন ॥ ৮৮ ॥

more yata bola — mora bujhibāra mana |
eka nibedana āche — śunaha bacana || 88 ||

more yata bola — all you say to Me; mora bujhibara mana — is to test My mind; eka nivedana achhe — I have one request; shunaha bachana — hear My words

88All that you say to Me is to test My mind.
I have one request — hear My words.

একদিন রাত্রিশেষে দেখিলুঁ স্বপন ।
সন্ন্যাসের মন্ত্র মোরে কহিল ব্রাহ্মণ ॥ ৮৯ ॥

ekadina rātriśeṣe dekhiluṁ sbapana |
sannyāsera mantra more kahila brāhmaṇa || 89 ||

ekadina ratri-sheshe — one day at the end of night; dekhilun svapana — I saw a dream; sannyasera mantra — the sannyasa mantra; more kahila brahmana — a brahmana told Me

89One day at the end of the night I had a dream:
a brahmana told Me the sannyasa mantra.

দেখ দেখি, এই বটে হয় কিবা নহে ।
ইহা বলি' ভারতীর কর্ণে মন্ত্র কহে ॥ ৯০ ॥

dekha dekhi, ei baṭe haẏa kibā nahe |
ihā bali' bhāratīra karṇe mantra kahe || 90 ||

dekha dekhi — see now; ei bate haya kiba nahe — is it this or not; iha bali — saying this; bharatira karne mantra kahe — speaks the mantra into Bharati's ear

90See now — is it this or not?" —
and saying this, He speaks the mantra into Bharati's ear.

ইহা বলি' সন্ন্যাসীর কর্ণে কহে মন্ত্র ।
প্রকারে হইলা গুরু আপনি স্বতন্ত্র ॥ ৯১ ॥

ihā bali' sannyāsīra karṇe kahe mantra |
prakāre hailā guru āpani sbatantra || 91 ||

iha bali — thus; sannyasira karne kahe mantra — speaks the mantra into the sannyasi's ear; prakare haila guru — on a pretext became guru; apani svatantra — the Independent One Himself

91Thus He spoke the mantra into the sannyasi's ear:
on a plausible pretext the independent [Lord] Himself became the guru.10

মন্ত্র শুনি' ন্যাসিবর হইলা প্রেমময় ।
কম্প পুলকিত অশ্রু, রাধাকৃষ্ণ কয় ॥ ৯১+১ ॥

mantra śuni' nyāsibara hailā premamaẏa |
kampa pulakita aśru, rādhākṛṣṇa kaẏa || 91+1 ||

mantra shuni — hearing the mantra; nyasivara haila premamaya — the best of sannyasis was filled with prema; kampa pulakita ashru — trembling, thrilling, tears; radha-krishna kaya — he says "Radha-Krishna"

91+1Hearing the mantra, the best of sannyasis was filled with prema:11
trembling, thrilling, in tears, he says, "Radha-Krishna!"

বৃন্দাবন যমুনা ফুকারে ঘনে ঘন ।
বুঝিল — এই সে কৃষ্ণ শচীর নন্দন ॥ ৯১+২ ॥

bṛndābana yamunā phukāre ghane ghana |
bujhila — ei se kṛṣṇa śacīra nandana || 91+2 ||

vrindavana yamuna — "Vrindavana! Yamuna!"; phukare ghane ghana — he cries again and again; bujhila — he understood; ei se krishna shachira nandana — this is Krishna Himself, Shachi's son

91+2Again and again he cries out: "Vrindavana! Yamuna!" —
he understood: "This is Krishna Himself, the son of Shachi.

ইঁহারে পিরীতি সেই ভাগ্য সর্বোত্তম ।
কৃষ্ণে প্রীতিহীন ধর্ম হয় ত অধম ॥ ৯১+৩ ॥

iṁhāre pirīti sei bhāgya sarbottama |
kṛṣṇe prītihīna dharma haẏa ta adhama || 91+3 ||

inhare piriti — love for Him; sei bhagya sarvottama — is the highest fortune; krishne pritihina dharma — dharma without love for Krishna; haya ta adhama — is base

91+3Love for Him is the highest fortune;
dharma without love for Krishna is base."

বুঝিল সকল কাজ ভারতী গোসাঞি ।
সন্ন্যাস করাব তোরে — শুনহ নিমাঞি ॥ ৯২ ॥

bujhila sakala kāja bhāratī gosāñi |
sannyāsa karāba tore — śunaha nimāñi || 92 ||

bujhila sakala kaja — understood everything; bharati gosani — Bharati Gosani; sannyasa karaba tore — I shall give You sannyasa; shunaha nimani — listen, Nimai

92Bharati Gosani understood everything:
"I shall give You sannyasa, listen, Nimai."

এ বোল শুনিয়া প্রভু নাচয়ে আনন্দে ।
'হরি হরি' বোলয়ে গম্ভীর মেঘনাদে ॥ ৯৩ ॥

e bola śuniẏā prabhu nācaẏe ānande |
'hari hari' bolaẏe gambhīra meghanāde || 93 ||

e bola shuniya — hearing this; prabhu nachaye anande — the Lord dances in joy; hari hari bolaye — cries "Hari, Hari"; gambhira meghanade — in a deep thundering voice

93Hearing this, the Lord dances in joy
and cries "Hari, Hari!" in a deep voice like thunder.

গৌর-শরীরে ভেল পুলক সারি সারি ।
অমিয়া পসারে যেন অঙ্গের মাধুরী ॥ ৯৪ ॥

gaura-śarīre bhela pulaka sāri sāri |
amiẏā pasāre yena aṅgera mādhurī || 94 ||

gaura-sharire — on Gaura's body; bhela pulaka sari sari — the hairs stood on end in rows; amiya pasare yena — as if spreading out a market of nectar; angera madhuri — the sweetness of His limbs

94On Gaura's golden body the hairs stood on end in rows —
the sweetness of His body seemed to spread out a market of nectar.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল ঝরে অনিবার ।
দেখিয়া সকল লোক করে হাহাকার ॥ ৯৫ ॥

aruṇa-naẏane jala jhare anibāra |
dekhiẏā sakala loka kare hāhākāra || 95 ||

aruna-nayane — from reddened eyes; jala jhare anivara — tears flow ceaselessly; dekhiya sakala loka — seeing this, all the people; kare hahakara — cry out in grief

95From His reddened eyes tears flow ceaselessly;
seeing this, all the people cry out in grief.

নবদ্বীপ হৈতে গদাধর নরহরি ।
আসিয়া মিলিলা তারা বলি' হরি হরি ॥ ৯৫+১ ॥

nabadbīpa haite gadādhara narahari |
āsiẏā mililā tārā bali' hari hari || 95+1 ||

navadvipa haite — from Navadvipa; gadadhara narahari — Gadadhara and Narahari; asiya milila tara — came and joined; bali hari hari — crying "Hari, Hari"

95+1From Navadvipa came Gadadhara and Narahari12
and joined [them], crying "Hari, Hari!"

দণ্ডবত প্রণতি করিলা বহুতর ।
হাসিয়া করিলা কোলে শচীর কোঙর ॥ ৯৫+২ ॥

daṇḍabata praṇati karilā bahutara |
hāsiẏā karilā kole śacīra koṅara || 95+2 ||

dandavata pranati — prostrations; karila bahutara — they made many times; hasiya karila kole — smiling, embraced; shachira kongara — Shachi's son

95+2Many times they prostrated themselves [before the Lord],
and Shachi's son, smiling, embraced them.

প্রভু কহে — ভাল হৈল তোমরা আইলা ।
কৃষ্ণ-অনুগ্রহ-হেতু তোমরা মিলিলা ॥ ৯৫+৩ ॥

prabhu kahe — bhāla haila tomarā āilā |
kṛṣṇa-anugraha-hetu tomarā mililā || 95+3 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; bhala haila tomara aila — it is good you came; krishna-anugraha-hetu — by Krishna's grace; tomara milila — you have met [Me]

95+3The Lord says: "It is good that you have come:
by Krishna's grace you have met [with Me].

আদ্যোপান্ত তোরা দুই সঙ্গী মোর সঙ্গে ।
তোদের দেখিয়া চিত্তে হয় বড় রঙ্গে ॥ ৯৫+৪ ॥

ādyopānta torā dui saṅgī mora saṅge |
todera dekhiẏā citte haẏa baṛa raṅge || 95+4 ||

adyopanta — from beginning to end; tora dui sangi mora sange — you two are My companions; todera dekhiya — seeing you; chitte haya bada range — My heart rejoices

95+4You two are My companions from beginning to end;
seeing you, My heart rejoices."

গৌর-মুখ দেখি' কান্দে দুই মহাশয় ।
ডাহিন বামেতে দোঁহে নিশ্চল রহয় ॥ ৯৫+৫ ॥

gaura-mukha dekhi' kānde dui mahāśaẏa |
ḍāhina bāmete doṁhe niścala rahaẏa || 95+5 ||

gaura-mukha dekhi — looking at Gaura's face; kande dui mahashaya — the two great souls weep; dahina bamete — on the right and left; donhe nishchala rahaya — both stand motionless

95+5Looking at Gaura's face, the two great souls weep;
both stand motionless to His right and left.

কাঞ্চননগরের লোক দেখিবারে ধায় ।
যে দেখয়ে — তার হিয়া-নয়ন জুড়ায় ॥ ৯৬ ॥

kāñcananagarera loka dekhibāre dhāẏa |
ye dekhaẏe — tāra hiẏā-naẏana juṛāẏa || 96 ||

kanchana-nagarera loka — the people of Kanchananagara; dekhibare dhaya — run to see; ye dekhaye — whoever sees; tara hiya-nayana judaya — his heart and eyes are refreshed

96The people of Kanchananagara run to see;
whoever sees [Him] — his heart and eyes are refreshed.

কিবা বৃদ্ধ, কিবা অন্ধ, কি নারী, পুরুষ ।
কিবা সে পণ্ডিতজন, এ গণ্ড-মুরুখ ॥ ৯৭ ॥

kibā bṛddha, kibā andha, ki nārī, puruṣa |
kibā se paṇḍitajana, e gaṇḍa-murukha || 97 ||

kiba vriddha kiba andha — old people, the blind; ki nari purusha — women, men; kiba se panditajana — the learned; e ganda-murukha — and utter fools

97Old people, the blind, women, men,
the learned and utter fools;

শিশুগণ ধায় আর কুলের যুবতী ।
নিজ ছায়া নাহি চিনে হেন রূপবতী ॥ ৯৮ ॥

śiśugaṇa dhāẏa āra kulera yubatī |
nija chāẏā nāhi cine hena rūpabatī || 98 ||

shishugana dhaya — children run; ara kulera yuvati — and young women of noble families; nija chhaya nahi chine — who do not know their own shadow; hena rupavati — such beauties

98children run, and young women of noble families —
so secluded they had never seen even their own shadow.13

কাঁখে কুম্ভ করি' কেহো দাঁড়াইয়া চাহে ।
নড়িতে না পারে সেহ লড়ি ধরি' ধায়ে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

kāṁkhe kumbha kari' keho dāṁṛāiẏā cāhe |
naṛite nā pāre seha laṛi dhari' dhāẏe || 99 ||

kankhe kumbha kari — with a pitcher on her hip; keho danraiya chahe — one stops and stares; nadite na pare — one who cannot walk; seha ladi dhari dhaye — hurries leaning on a stick

99One, with a pitcher on her hip, has stopped and stares;
one who cannot walk hurries along leaning on a stick.

পঙ্গু সে আতুর কিবা গর্ভবতী নারী ।
শ্রীঅঙ্গ দেখিয়া সন্ন্যাসীরে পাড়ে গালি ॥ ১০০ ॥

paṅgu se ātura kibā garbhabatī nārī |
śrīaṅga dekhiẏā sannyāsīre pāṛe gāli || 100 ||

pangu se atura — the lame, the infirm; kiba garbhavati nari — pregnant women; sri-anga dekhiya — seeing the holy body; sannyasire pade gali — revile the sannyasi

100The lame, the infirm, pregnant women —
seeing His holy body, they revile the sannyasi.

এমন বালকে কেহো করায় সন্ন্যাস ।
সন্ন্যাসীর ধর্ম নহে, লোকে উপহাস ॥ ১০০+১ ॥

emana bālake keho karāẏa sannyāsa |
sannyāsīra dharma nahe, loke upahāsa || 100+1 ||

emana balake — to such a boy; keho karaya sannyasa — who gives sannyasa; sannyasira dharma nahe — it is not a sannyasi's dharma; loke upahasa — people will mock

100+1"Who gives sannyasa to such a boy?14
It does not befit a sannyasi — people will laugh.

কঠিন অন্তর ইহার — দয়াহীন জন ।
নগরে না রাখি ইহায় — কহিল কথন ॥ ১০০+২ ॥

kaṭhina antara ihāra — daẏāhīna jana |
nagare nā rākhi ihāẏa — kahila kathana || 100+2 ||

kathina antara ihara — hard is his heart; dayahina jana — a pitiless man; nagare na rakhi ihaya — let us not keep him in the town; kahila kathana — so they said

100+2Hard is his heart, a pitiless man:
let us not keep him in the town!" — so they said.

সন্ন্যাসীরে সবে নিন্দা করে বারবার ।
গোরা-মুখ দেখি' সভার আনন্দ অপার ॥ ১০০+৩ ॥

sannyāsīre sabe nindā kare bārabāra |
gorā-mukha dekhi' sabhāra ānanda apāra || 100+3 ||

sannyasire sabe ninda kare — all revile the sannyasi; bara-bara — again and again; gora-mukha dekhi — looking at Gora's face; sabhara ananda apara — all are in boundless joy

100+3All revile the sannyasi again and again,
yet looking at Gora's face, all are in boundless joy.

ধন্য ধন্য করি' লোক বাখানয়ে রূপ ।
এতকালে দেখিল এ অতি অপরূপ ॥ ১০১ ॥

dhanya dhanya kari' loka bākhānaẏe rūpa |
etakāle dekhila e ati aparūpa || 101 ||

dhanya dhanya kari — saying "blessed"; loka vakhanaye rupa — the people extol His beauty; etakale dekhila — at last we have seen; e ati aparupa — something so wondrous

101"Blessed, blessed!" people say, extolling His beauty:
"At last we have seen something so wondrous!

ধন্য ধন্য জননী — ধরিল পুত্র গর্ভে ।
দেবকী-সমান সেই, শুনিয়াছি পূর্বে ॥ ১০২ ॥

dhanya dhanya jananī — dharila putra garbhe |
debakī-samāna sei, śuniẏāchi pūrbe || 102 ||

dhanya dhanya janani — blessed is the mother; dharila putra garbhe — who bore the son in her womb; devaki-samana sei — she is like Devaki; shuniyachhi purve — of whom we heard of old

102Blessed, blessed is the mother who bore [such] a son in her womb:
she is like Devaki, of whom we have heard of old.

কোন্ ভাগ্যবতী হেন পাইয়াছিল পতি ।
ত্রৈলোক্যে তাহার সম নাহি ভাগ্যবতী ॥ ১০৩ ॥

kon bhāgyabatī hena pāiẏāchila pati |
trailokye tāhāra sama nāhi bhāgyabatī || 103 ||

kon bhagyavati — what fortunate woman; hena paiyachhila pati — obtained such a husband; trailokye tahara sama — in the three worlds her equal; nahi bhagyavati — in fortune there is none

103What fortunate woman obtained such a husband?
In the three worlds there is none her equal in fortune.

রূপ দেখি' নিজ আঁখি পালটিতে নারি ।
ইঁহার সন্ন্যাস কিবা সহিবারে পারি ॥ ১০৪ ॥

rūpa dekhi' nija āṁkhi pālaṭite nāri |
iṁhāra sannyāsa kibā sahibāre pāri || 104 ||

rupa dekhi — seeing the beauty; nija ankhi palatite nari — we cannot turn our eyes away; inhara sannyasa — His sannyasa; kiba sahibare pari — how can we bear

104Seeing His beauty, we cannot turn our eyes away —
how shall we bear His sannyasa?

কেমনে বা জীবে সেই ইঁহার জননী ।
এ কথা শুনিলে মাত্র মরিবে রমণী ॥ ১০৫ ॥

kemane bā jībe sei iṁhāra jananī |
e kathā śunile mātra maribe ramaṇī || 105 ||

kemane va jive — how will she live; sei inhara janani — His mother; e katha shunile matra — as soon as she hears this; maribe ramani — the woman will die

105How will His mother live?
Hearing of this, she will die at once.

হেন বুঝি — মাতা পিতা নাহিক ইঁহার ।
ইঁহো সে অচ্যুতানন্দ সর্ব-বেদ-সার ॥ ১০৫+১ ॥

hena bujhi — mātā pitā nāhika iṁhāra |
iṁho se acyutānanda sarba-beda-sāra || 105+1 ||

hena bujhi — so we think; mata pita nahika inhara — He has neither mother nor father; inho se achyutananda — He is unfailing bliss itself; sarva-veda-sara — the essence of all the Vedas

105+1We think He has neither mother nor father:15
He is Himself unfailing bliss (Achyuta-ananda), the essence of all the Vedas.

বৃন্দাবন-মাঝে কিবা রাধা হারাইয়া ।
তার অন্বেষণে বুলে কান্দিয়া কান্দিয়া ॥ ১০৫+২ ॥

bṛndābana-mājhe kibā rādhā hārāiẏā |
tāra anbeṣaṇe bule kāndiẏā kāndiẏā || 105+2 ||

vrindavana-majhe — in Vrindavana; kiba radha haraiya — having perhaps lost Radha; tara anveshane — in search of Her; bule kandiya kandiya — He wanders weeping and weeping

105+2Has He perhaps lost Radha in Vrindavana?
Searching for Her, He wanders weeping and weeping.

সে বিরহে ভেল ইঁহার সন্ন্যাস-করণ ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল — এই নন্দের নন্দন ॥ ১০৫+৩ ॥

se birahe bhela iṁhāra sannyāsa-karaṇa |
niścaẏa jānila — ei nandera nandana || 105+3 ||

se virahe — from that separation; bhela inhara sannyasa-karana — He is taking sannyasa; nishchaya janila — we know for certain; ei nandera nandana — this is Nanda's son

105+3Because of that separation He is taking sannyasa:
we know for certain — this is the son of Nanda."

এত অনুমান করি' কান্দে সব লোক ।
ডাকিয়া কহয়ে প্রভু — না করিহ শোক ॥ ১০৬ ॥

eta anumāna kari' kānde saba loka |
ḍākiẏā kahaẏe prabhu — nā kariha śoka || 106 ||

eta anumana kari — thinking thus; kande saba loka — all the people weep; dakiya kahaye prabhu — the Lord calls and says; na kariha shoka — do not grieve

106Thinking thus, all the people weep.
The Lord calls them and says: "Do not grieve.

আশীর্বাদ কর মোরে — শুন মাতা পিতা ।
সাধ লাগে কৃষ্ণের চরণে দেঙ মাথা ॥ ১০৭ ॥

āśīrbāda kara more — śuna mātā pitā |
sādha lāge kṛṣṇera caraṇe deṅa māthā || 107 ||

ashirvada kara more — bless Me; shuna mata pita — mothers and fathers; sadha lage — I long; krishnera charane denga matha — to lay My head at Krishna's feet

107Bless Me, mothers and fathers:
I long to lay My head at Krishna's feet.

যার যেই নিজ পতি সেই তাহা চাহে ।
তার চিত্ত বান্ধিবারে করয়ে উপায়ে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

yāra yei nija pati sei tāhā cāhe |
tāra citta bāndhibāre karaẏe upāẏe || 108 ||

yara yei nija pati — she who has her own husband; sei taha chahe — longs for him; tara chitta bandhibare — to bind his heart; karaye upaye — seeks means

108She who has her own husband longs for him
and seeks means to bind his heart.

রূপ, যৌবন যত এ রস-লাবণ্য ।
নিজ পতি ভজিলে সে সব হয় ধন্য ॥ ১০৯ ॥

rūpa, yaubana yata e rasa-lābaṇya |
nija pati bhajile se saba haẏa dhanya || 109 ||

rupa yauvana yata — beauty, youth, all; e rasa-lavanya — this rasa and loveliness; nija pati bhajile — in serving one's own husband; se saba haya dhanya — all becomes blessed

109Beauty, youth, all this rasa and loveliness —
all is blessed when it serves one's own husband.

মনে মনে কর এ সভার অনুভব ।
পতি বিনু যুবতীর মিছা হয় সব ॥ ১১০ ॥

mane mane kara e sabhāra anubhaba |
pati binu yubatīra michā haẏa saba || 110 ||

mane mane kara — consider in your hearts; e sabhara anubhava — all of you, this; pati vinu — without a husband; yuvatira michha haya saba — all a young woman has is vain

110Consider this, all of you, in your hearts:
without a husband, all a young woman has is in vain.

কৃষ্ণপদ বিনু মোর নাহি অন্য গতি ।
নিজ অঙ্গ দিয়া মুঞি ভজিব প্রাণপতি ॥ ১১১ ॥

kṛṣṇapada binu mora nāhi anya gati |
nija aṅga diẏā muñi bhajiba prāṇapati || 111 ||

krishna-pada vinu — apart from Krishna's feet; mora nahi anya gati — I have no other refuge; nija anga diya — giving My whole Self; munni bhajiba pranapati — I shall serve the Lord of My life

111Apart from Krishna's feet I have no other refuge:
giving My whole Self, I shall serve the Lord of My life."16

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু করিয়ে রোদন ।
ক্ষণেক অন্তরে সব কৈল সম্বরণ ॥ ১১২ ॥

ihā bali' mahāprabhu kariẏe rodana |
kṣaṇeka antare saba kaila sambaraṇa || 112 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu kariye rodana — Mahaprabhu wept; kshaneka antare — after a moment; saba kaila samvarana — He held everything back

112Saying this, Mahaprabhu wept,
but in a moment He held everything back [within Himself].

✦

Notes

  1. The OCR of the summary is badly garbled; gaps are filled by sense and from the table of contents in the edition's preface (ch. 13: "consolation of the devotees by instruction in the truth; leaving home, the Lord goes to Kantakanagara, to Keshava Bharati; Nityananda Prabhu consoles Shachi and Vishnupriya; Nityananda's coming to Kantakanagara with Chandrashekhara Acharya, Damodara Pandita and other devotees; the Lord's request for the sannyasa mantra, Bharati's refusal and consent; the Lord speaks the sannyasa mantra into Bharati's ear; the grief of the villagers; the Lord consoles them and, as a devotee, asks for devotion to Krishna; the Lord's sannyasa name — Sri Krishna Chaitanya; after sannyasa, wandering in Radha-desha absorbed in prema"). The summary runs ahead: the end of the section is in the next portion. In the 1983 edition the disha is longer: "Why have You become like this, Gauranga, why? Why have You given up the dress of the best of dancers? Stand just a moment on the bank of the Ganga, Nimai, let me gaze at Your moon-face — and then go. If You will keep one word of mine, Nimai — no need of sannyasa, stay at home. Do not become a sannyasi, Nimai, do not become a vairagi, do not leave Your unfortunate mother. Your mother calls: stay, O Gauranga; do not go leaving Your mother, O Gauranga!"
  2. Kantakanagara is Katwa, on the west bank of the Ganga. Below (vv. 38, 51, 96) Lochana Dasa calls it Kanchananagara; the 1983 edition has that name here too.
  3. According to svara-shastra, setting out when the breath flows through the right nostril is a good omen.
  4. Cf. Murari 3.1.7: "Bhagavan crossed the divine river and went away."
  5. That is, like Krishna entering the arena against Kamsa's wrestlers in Mathura.
  6. Lochana Dasa here depicts the Lord in the mood of Krishna pining for Radha; according to the teaching of the Gaudiya Vaishnavas (Krishnadasa Kaviraja, Bhaktisiddhanta), Gaura is Krishna in the bhava of Radha, tasting Her love for Krishna; so Bhaktisiddhanta also interprets a similar passage above (en/35, note 5).
  7. "Narayana!" is the customary greeting of sannyasis.
  8. Bharati speaks by the general rule of sannyasa, that with age the senses grow calm. Worldly passions have no bearing on the Lord, whose body and senses are spiritual; in the lila Bharati speaks to Him as to a young brahmana.
  9. Maya here means "dissembling, pretence": the Lord asks Bharati not to evade Him with plausible excuses. So also in v. 67.
  10. Cf. Murari 3.2.7–9: "Thus the one Lord of the worlds… on a plausible pretext gave initiation to His own guru." On the meaning of the sannyasa mantra see en/35, note 10. In the lila Keshava Bharati is the Lord's sannyasa-guru; the Lord, the guru of the world, Himself accepts him as guru in order to establish reverence for the guru.
  11. Vv. 91+1 — 91+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript (with one more couplet).
  12. Vv. 95+1 — 95+5 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Narahari Sarakara is Lochana Dasa's guru. The Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 28) also speaks of Gadadhara at Katwa.
  13. Lit. "so beautiful that they do not recognise their own shadow" — that is, they live in seclusion and never go out in public.
  14. Vv. 100+1 — 100+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript.
  15. Vv. 105+1 — 105+3 are found only in the 1983 edition; in the 1903 edition they are in a footnote, as an additional reading of one manuscript. Vv. 96–107 — cf. Murari 3.1.10–18 and 3.2.2.
  16. The Lord speaks in the mood of a gopi: Krishna is the one husband of all souls (cf. en/38, note 7).
